chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: that he was asked about a young boy whom a woman washes, and he said:
"It is only women who wash young boys." And regarding a young girl, if no woman is found to wash her, he said: "A man who is the most entitled of people to her should wash her."

key_terms.أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهَا: the person most entitled or closest in right to her
key_terms.الصِّبْيَانَ: young boys or children in the masculine form
key_terms.تُغَسِّلُهُ: washes him, referring to the ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: Who may wash the body of a deceased child according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling regarding washing the deceased among children. It states that women wash young boys, and if a young girl has no woman available to wash her, then the man most closely entitled to her may wash her.
